title: Phase 2：反例搜尋器第二批（數論）：推翻 A362070（a(1715) = a(1716) = 91）

A362070.proof: a(1715) = a(1716) = 91 (1715 = 5*7^3, K = 21; 1716 = 2^2*3*11*13, K = 13, m_min = 14 - r). Lean a362070_counterexample (core, kernel computation of the literal definition). Entry's own Maxima program agrees. Least and only solution with n <= 10^10 (sieve, 128-bit sums). Side question a(n) = n: no new solution <= 10^10.

A332786.proof: No composite m <= 10^5 other than 49 has m | a(m); none has m^2 | a(m). Exact q-adic valuation, cross-checked with fractions for m <= 600.

A349093.proof: Not rescanned; DISC-0019 smooth-pair check stands.

A266651.proof: Already proved by Hao Pan (2016) per the entry; skipped.

novelty.note: Elementary computation; nothing new is claimed beyond pointing out the counterexample. The entry says the conjecture was checked to 10^4, which contains 1715. Web, MathSciNet and zbMATH not searched.
